name: AnyRouter
description: A distinct gateway offering five no-card trial requests on free and decision models.
overview: AnyRouter at anyrouter.dev says new accounts can try five requests without a card. Continued free-model access requires the paid Go plan or donation of a valid unique upstream provider key. It is not the similarly named AgentRouter. Older promotional articles conflict with current plan terms; use the current pricing page.
free_access: Five trial requests with no card
Continued access requires Go subscription or donated key
Older articles conflict with current terms
notes: Base URL https://anyrouter.dev/api/v1. A donated key may have upstream costs and privacy implications.
